Name: PermaDeath
Author: IronManEnthusiast
Description:
Hate yourself? Want to make your game exponentially harder? Try PermaDeath!

With this mod installed, no longer will you wake up at the doctor with a couple of ouchies and boo-boos. Much like real life, you only get one chance. If you die, that's it. Game over!

To prevent you from save scumming your file, this mod will auto-delete your save immediately upon your death.

Say goodbye to all your fellow peers, because you won't be seeing them again in this lifetime!

[i]This mod is presented as is, and will not be updated going forward. Enjoy every second of your save, because you never know when it will be your last![/i]

Manifest.Name: PermaDeath
Manifest.Description: A mod that permanently deletes your save if you die.
